stem:
Two small solid metal spheres A and B have equal radii and are in a vacuum. Their centres are $15\text{ cm}$ apart.
Sphere A has charge $+3.0\text{ pC}$ and sphere B has charge $+12\text{ pC}$. The arrangement is illustrated in Fig. 5.1.
{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}
Point P lies on the line joining the centres of the spheres and is a distance of $5.0\text{ cm}$ from the centre of sphere A.
